instruction: I want my laptop to automatically suspend when idle to save battery. Can you enable automatic suspend?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic suspend when idle on AC power. Config sets sleep-inactive-ac-type to 'nothing', instruction asks to enable suspend. The evaluator checks if the setting is 'suspend' (note: string values in gsettings are returned with single quotes). Uses existing exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.
